title: AttemptEvent
description: WO-014.1 Attempt Event — append-only record of one verified student solving attempt. Used to update Student Learning State counters only. No mastery, weakness inference, recommendation, or error-cause assignment.

event_id.description: Globally unique attempt event id (append-only; never reuse).

student_id.description: Learner id matching Student Learning State.student_id.

question_id.description: Existing question_id only. Never invent. Must not modify Question DB.

pattern_id.description: Pattern link at attempt time. Must exist in data/pattern-master-db.json. Preferred: validation_status=verified. Not a reclassification write.

selected_answer.description: Student-selected choice as recorded by UI/engine. Typically 1-based choice index (integer) or explicit label string. Not an Answer SoT mutation.

correct_answer_reference.description: Pointer to Answer SoT / Product answer field. Stores reference metadata, not authority to edit answers.

source.description: Read-only path or logical source id (e.g. data/question-db.json, pilot candidate path, attested answer-manifest).

question_id.description: Question id used to look up the correct answer in source.

field.description: Field name inside the source record.

result.description: Verified grading outcome for this attempt. Must be derived by comparing selected_answer to the referenced SoT answer at ingest time — not guessed.

status.description: accepted = applied to Learning State counters; rejected = validation failed (not applied).
